关键词: combat description|fighting|action|battle scenes
意图与同义词: how to write combat|how to write a fight|staging a battle
大模型指令: Advance from probing to confrontation, reversal, and climax; do not flatten techniques and outcomes into one undifferentiated exchange.
核心摘要: Build a clear progression: test the opponent, escalate the conflict, then use a decisive turn to create the climax.
详细展开: Alternate action, sensory detail, and tactical changes. Increase the pressure of costs and decisions toward the end instead of merely listing named attacks.
说明: Move through probing, confrontation, reversal, and climax, giving successive stages more space while advancing sensory detail and tactical changes together.
示例片段: He twisted aside, the fist's wake whistling past his ear. His feet drove against the ground, and he shot forward like an arrow released—
毒点: They started fighting. Punches and kicks went back and forth for a long time. Finally, the protagonist won.

关键词: dialogue voice|dialogue description|character dialogue|distinct voices
意图与同义词: distinguishing speech patterns|how different characters speak|identifying speakers by voice
大模型指令: Establish each speaker's identity, relationships, and mood before assigning vocabulary, sentence length, and subtext. Avoid giving everyone the same formal voice.
核心摘要: Differentiate speakers through vocabulary, sentence length, subtext, and emotional responses, not dialogue tags alone.
详细展开: Give central speakers consistent differences in syntax, politeness, modes of attack, or verbal habits within the same conversation.
说明: Vocabulary, sentence length, and habitual expressions should reveal each speaker's personality.
示例片段: 'Three hundred years of cultivation, and never once have I feared another soul!' the elder declared. 'Sure. Keep telling yourself that,' the boy said.
毒点: Everyone speaks in identical formal prose, so readers cannot identify speakers from their dialogue.

关键词: volume-level narrative|narrative function|volume structure|plot pacing
意图与同义词: planning a volume|breaking down volume structure|arranging narrative rhythm
大模型指令: Define each volume's narrative purpose before scheduling advancement, conflict, and payoffs. Avoid consecutive volumes that merely repeat power progression.
核心摘要: Distinguish introductory, developmental, climactic, and transitional volumes to prevent repetition and pacing fatigue.
详细展开: Decide what this volume resolves, what it develops, and what it leaves open before choosing chapter count or climax placement.
说明: An introductory volume establishes the world and goals; a development volume advances conflict and growth; a climax fulfills the main promise; a transition prepares a new setting.
示例片段: Volume One: the supposed failure awakens, finds a mentor, and wins a first battle. Its introductory function is to establish the world and the protagonist's goal.
毒点: Three consecutive volumes consist only of defeating monsters and leveling up, exhausting the reader.

关键词: plot pattern|concealed strength|humiliating a detractor|feigned weakness and eruption
意图与同义词: writing concealed strength|writing a satisfying rebuttal|foreshadowing a counterattack
大模型指令: Establish an information gap and pressure before concentrating the counterattack at a decisive moment. Do not make the eruption costless or dependent on suddenly foolish opponents.
核心摘要: A concealed-strength reversal first places the protagonist in an underestimated position, then turns hidden knowledge or a secret advantage into a decisive reversal.
详细展开: Show who misjudges the protagonist, why the protagonist waits, and what the eventual reveal will change.
说明: Hidden strength, mistaken assumptions, and accumulated frustration create satisfaction when the eventual payoff matches the earlier suppression.
示例片段: Everyone took him for an errand-running novice. Then the trial arena opened, his single sword stroke shattered its formation, and the presiding elder fell speechless.
毒点: An insult is immediately followed by a costless cheat-powered instant victory, with no buildup or basis for reversal.

关键词: everyday scene|ensemble interaction|slice of life|lighthearted scene
意图与同义词: writing everyday scenes|ensemble downtime without filler|writing slice of life
大模型指令: Give characters a concrete activity, then embed dialogue, foreshadowing, and relationship shifts in its steps. Avoid a group standing still to chat.
核心摘要: Cooking, tidying, or dividing loot can carry ensemble dialogue, allowing relaxed scenes to advance relationships and setup.
详细展开: Give each participant distinct actions and gestures so speech, silence, mistakes, and observation convey information rather than pad the word count.
说明: Use a shared activity to support conversation and changing relationships, giving a light scene a clear purpose.
示例片段: As oil crackled in the pan, the notoriously sharp-tongued second disciple put the best piece of meat in her bowl. 'Just don't slow us down,' he muttered.
毒点: The group sits chatting for an entire chapter, with neither a concrete activity nor new information.

关键词: trial|debate|chain of evidence|courtroom confrontation
意图与同义词: writing courtroom scenes|writing debates|sequencing evidence reversals
大模型指令: Advance the hearing through evidence and procedural contests, not sheer volume or declarations of allegiance.
核心摘要: Courtroom and debate payoffs come from establishing evidence, exposing flaws, and overturning a position, not shouting louder.
详细展开: Give one side a procedural advantage, then overturn it through a contradictory timeline, decisive physical evidence, or a procedural weakness.
说明: Use for courtroom hearings, court debates, and public arguments governed by rules and evidence.
示例片段: He did not rush to object. He projected the surveillance timestamp onto the screen, and the witness who had seemed so certain suddenly stopped breathing.
毒点: Both sides trade accusations without advancing the evidence, until the author abruptly announces the truth.

关键词: reunion|rekindled romance|meeting after years apart|encountering an ex
意图与同义词: writing a long-awaited reunion|staging romantic reconciliation|writing an encounter with an ex
大模型指令: Combine outward restraint, involuntary physical reactions, and changed identities. Do not let the characters shout out every feeling at first sight.
核心摘要: Reunion tension comes from the gap between outward composure and bodily betrayal, and between who people were and who they have become.
详细展开: Use a public setting, professional role, or third party to enforce restraint, letting an ordinary greeting contain old wounds and hidden currents.
说明: Suited to reconciliation, renewed love, and former friends meeting after a rupture.
示例片段: Her voice was steady when she said, 'It's been a while.' Only the crumpled boarding pass revealed that her hand had never stopped shaking.
毒点: The reunion immediately unloads every grievance and secret, reducing the scene to exposition.

关键词: action pacing|five-beat combat|action scene|combat beats
意图与同义词: pacing an action scene|dividing a fight into stages|structuring action
大模型指令: Use five beats: engagement, imbalance, reversal, climax, and aftermath. Do not carry the entire fight at one unchanging speed.
核心摘要: A five-beat structure keeps the situation, speed, and sense of danger changing throughout the action.
详细展开: Establish spatial relationships on engagement, create imbalance and counterpressure, reverse the situation through environment or judgment, then close with consequences.
说明: Suited to duels, pursuits, and compact high-intensity action sequences.
示例片段: The first clash of blades was only a test. When his foot slipped and drove him to the roof's edge, the fight finally began to turn.
毒点: From the first line to the last, opponents merely slash at each other without tactical changes or shifts in rhythm.

关键词: spotting weaknesses|one-hit finish|precise counterattack|combat analysis
意图与同义词: writing a weakness|staging a decisive strike|analyzing an opening
大模型指令: Let analysis build tension, but make the strike swift and precise. Do not turn spotting a weakness into a prolonged lecture.
核心摘要: Connect observation, judgment, and execution in one line of action. The clearer the analysis, the cleaner the finish should be.
详细展开: An eye technique, system marker, or exceptional tactical intelligence can let the protagonist exploit a fleeting opening to reverse the fight.
说明: Pay off extended judgment with minimal movement, making combat intelligence itself satisfying.
示例片段: He was not waiting for the monster's jaws to open. He wanted the half-beat when its heel went weightless after that huge palm struck the ground. That was its only fatal opening.
毒点: Lengthy explanations of the weakness lead to a hesitant attack, and victory still depends on overwhelming statistics.

关键词: rendezvous code|spy meeting|teahouse rendezvous|undercover contact
意图与同义词: writing a covert meeting|designing code phrases|building tension in an undercover rendezvous
大模型指令: Make the code sound like ordinary small talk, and establish an abort signal. Let everyday camouflage carry the danger.
核心摘要: A spy meeting gains tension from multiple meanings beneath ordinary dialogue and the possibility that one wrong word will expose someone.
详细展开: Teahouses, bookshops, and park benches work well. Embed signals in the setting and gestures, then add pressure from an approaching tail or patrol.
说明: Exchange intelligence through greetings, object placement, or ordering habits while preserving a way to abort.
示例片段: 'Dry weather today,' he said, turning his teacup halfway around. The man opposite smiled. 'Still, the fish aren't biting.'
毒点: Contacts state their intelligence openly as soon as they meet, as if trying to make sure bystanders hear.

关键词: winning shot|sports competition|final possession|match climax
意图与同义词: writing a last-second winner|writing the final shot|staging a sporting climax
大模型指令: Slow subjective time before the decisive move. Compress breath, crowd noise, and muscular feedback into the instant instead of merely announcing the result.
核心摘要: Use slow-motion perception and contrasting environmental noise to make a single second carry the weight of the match.
详细展开: Squeaking soles, the clock, and a crowd holding its breath can concentrate the whole contest into the final release.
说明: Suited to buzzer-beaters, finish-line overtakes, and decisive penalty kicks.
示例片段: The arena's roar receded as he jumped. All that remained was the dry rasp of leather against his palm and the clock's final half-second.
毒点: After a long match, the decisive play is dismissed with 'He scored, and the crowd went wild.'

关键词: tactical gestures|silent entry|squad coordination|special operations
意图与同义词: writing special operations|staging a silent breach|using tactical hand signals
大模型指令: Synchronize gestures, clipped radio calls, and movement. Convey expertise through coordination, not terminology overload.
核心摘要: Minimal communication and practiced coordination create tactical credibility; silence can heighten the pressure.
详细展开: Connect familiar freeze, observe, flank, and engage signals to terrain and timing so the entry remains clear and tense.
说明: Suited to breaching, urban combat, ambushes, and rescues involving trained teams.
示例片段: The leader raised a fist, and the corridor froze. Two fingers pointed to his eyes, then swept toward the corner; the last man was already sliding along the wall.
毒点: During a dangerous operation, squad members deliver long tactical explanations as if conducting a debrief.

关键词: prebattle rally|epic speech|raising morale|mass chant
意图与同义词: writing a prebattle speech|staging a morale boost|creating epic dialogue
大模型指令: Acknowledge fear, name what is worth fighting for, then close with a short rallying cry. Avoid an uninterrupted stream of grand abstractions.
核心摘要: A strong rally moves from shared fear to a higher purpose and a concise slogan, lifting morale out of dread.
详细展开: A stirring speech does not evade death. It first makes soldiers feel understood, then leads them toward a shared conviction.
说明: Suited to the eve of battle, a desperate counterattack, or the uprising of a rebel army.
示例片段: 'I know you're afraid.' He did not raise his voice, yet even the wind seemed to pause. 'But behind you is home.'
毒点: The speech invokes glory and victory without a concrete audience or an emotional progression.

关键词: system announcement|global evolution|heavenly proclamation|apocalypse opening
意图与同义词: writing a system's arrival|opening with a global announcement|starting an apocalypse story
大模型指令: Make the announcement cold, brief, and irresistible. Collective transformations and instantly effective rules should change the world before lengthy explanations begin.
核心摘要: An authoritative system voice and simultaneous worldwide anomalies can end the old world within a few sentences.
详细展开: A voice inside every mind, a sky turned into a screen, or rules taking immediate effect quickly establishes overwhelming power and opening pressure.
说明: Overturn the old order through one synchronized global event; suited to gamified apocalypse, global evolution, and infinite-instance openings.
示例片段: Welcome to Earth 2.0. The voice came neither from the sky nor beside their ears. It pressed against every retina like a strip of cold iron.
毒点: The announcement recites a lengthy setting manual while the actual crisis never arrives.

关键词: black market|underground trading|contraband sales|forbidden atmosphere
意图与同义词: writing a black market|giving underground trades atmosphere|staging contraband exchanges
大模型指令: Create forbidden tension through whispered prices, face-covering rules, and risk warnings. Make the market feel capable of erupting at any moment.
核心摘要: A black market is defined less by its selection than by the illicit danger surrounding every stall and transaction.
详细展开: Masks, passwords, cursed objects, stolen provenance, and pursuing authorities distinguish it from an ordinary market.
说明: Use rules, risks, and hushed communication to separate the underground economy from legitimate trade.
示例片段: Without looking up, the merchant slid over a blackened ring. Beside it lay a note: WEAR AT YOUR OWN RISK.
毒点: The black market is indistinguishable from a shopping mall except for the merchants' sinister names.

关键词: dream labyrinth|spatial distortion|subconscious scene|trauma landscape
意图与同义词: writing dreams|creating spatial distortion|staging a subconscious maze
大模型指令: Ground dream distortions in the character's trauma. Doors opening into the wrong rooms or breathable seawater should correspond to inner conflicts.
核心摘要: A dream labyrinth needs both distorted space and distorted emotion, so readers sense strangeness and recognize projected trauma.
详细展开: Deeper layers should depart further from reality. Symbols and shadow selves bring forward what the character refuses to face.
说明: Turn inner trauma into a traversable, confrontable landscape through spatial anomalies and symbolic objects.
示例片段: He opened the bedroom door onto that sea he could never reach the bottom of. His bedside table still hovered above the water, rocking slowly.
毒点: The dream piles up bizarre images unrelated to the character's experiences.

关键词: recap|between-volume recap|previous-volume summary|end-of-volume reflection
意图与同义词: dramatizing a recap|naturally revisiting the previous volume|avoiding dry summaries
大模型指令: Focus on turning points, losses, and changes. Return readers to the main plot through a character's voice or emotionally inflected narration, not a chronological inventory.
核心摘要: An effective between-volume recap compresses the most important changes into an emotionally charged backward glance.
详细展开: Use an internal monologue, narration, old friends taking stock, or silence after a celebration to reaffirm the previous volume's costs and achievements.
说明: Before a new volume, quickly restore the main plot and emotional temperature while confirming how the characters have changed.
示例片段: Only at the imperial capital's gates did he realize he had left the boy who knew nothing but running for his life in the previous volume's flames.
毒点: Events from dozens of chapters are mechanically listed in order, like a weekly work report.

关键词: next-volume teaser|volume ending|new-volume hook|preview scene
意图与同义词: teasing the next volume|writing a next-volume hook|making closure enticing
大模型指令: At the volume's close, hint at the approaching storm and its central lure. Do not insert a synopsis of the next volume into the narrative.
核心摘要: A good teaser tells readers that something larger is coming without revealing its true shape.
详细展开: A distant anomaly, a secret order, an old enemy's return, or a newly opened map can provide a light hook during closure.
说明: After settling this volume's emotions, gently open the next volume's door to sustain the urge to continue.
示例片段: The victory banquet's drums were still beating when a black-feathered arrow from the northern frontier struck a palace pillar. Its message contained only two words: RETURN NOW.
毒点: The current volume ends and immediately launches into a detailed explanation of the next setting, villain, and every mission.

关键词: rule announcement|instance entry|rules broadcast|uncanny opening
意图与同义词: introducing rules|writing an instance entrance|creating a rules broadcast
大模型指令: Make the rules initially sound like ordinary notices, then slip an anomaly into one or two. Let horror emerge from the shell of order.
核心摘要: An entrance framed by rules is gripping when official, calm, apparently normal language contains unmistakably abnormal demands.
详细展开: Broadcasts, noticeboards, employee manuals, and school rules can carry the message; ordinary formats are especially effective for the first layer of strangeness.
说明: Combine formal text with immediate reactions to establish the instance's rules, danger, and room for deduction.
示例片段: Welcome to the aquarium. If you hear dolphins after closing time, immediately move away from all bodies of water.
毒点: Characters explain that the place is terrifying, but no observable rule takes effect.

关键词: sealing ritual|countdown spellcasting|magic circle|unsealing crisis
意图与同义词: writing a sealing scene|making rituals oppressive|staging countdown spellcasting
大模型指令: Put incantations, movements, materials, backlash, and the countdown onstage together. Every step should feel perilously close to failure.
核心摘要: A sealing ritual draws tension from ordered steps poised on the edge of losing control.
详细展开: A formation lighting section by section, insufficient offerings, a target fighting back, or a caster coughing blood can give the ritual concrete beats.
说明: Strict steps and limited time create pressure, suited to a major climax or the moments before catastrophe.
示例片段: As the seventh chain of light dragged itself from the earth, the lead caster's wrist cracked. Only three breaths remained before the formation's heart closed.
毒点: One elegant incantation stands in for the whole ritual, with no process, cost, or risk of failure.

关键词: commentary booth|referee analysis|academy duel|third-party tactical commentary
意图与同义词: writing a narrated duel|using referee commentary in combat|clarifying an academy match
大模型指令: Explain only decisive techniques and the causes of mistakes. Do not narrate every move like an instructional video.
核心摘要: Third-party commentary can clarify complex combat and add drama when a confident prediction proves wrong.
详细展开: Academy competitions, public arenas, and televised matches provide natural opportunities to explain why a move is powerful or a step mistaken.
说明: Use a referee, mentor, or commentator to magnify tactical significance and audience reactions.
示例片段: 'The ice mirror isn't reflecting the fireball. It's absorbing the temperature difference!' Before the instructor finished, the fire mage had already misplaced a second step.
毒点: The commentary repeats every action until readers tire before the spectators do.

关键词: group meeting|ensemble dialogue|undercurrents in a meeting|speaker identification
意图与同义词: writing group conversations|keeping meeting scenes clear|adding tension to group deliberation
大模型指令: Tie speech to gestures and shifts in position. Watch the people who do not speak, so silence also carries information.
核心摘要: A compelling meeting does not require everyone to talk; it requires everyone to participate differently in the struggle.
详细展开: A leader issues orders, a joker eases tension, a guilty participant answers too quickly, and a silent observer watches. These contrasting functions animate the scene.
说明: Suited to planning sessions, war councils, family disputes, and assigning team roles.
示例片段: While everyone argued over the route, the man who had never spoken quietly rotated the map in his corner, as though checking where the exits were.
毒点: Everyone takes turns delivering lines, with no movement, observation, or differences in unspoken attitude.

关键词: nonlinear opening|funeral opening|flash-forward opening|outcome first
意图与同义词: writing an outcome-first opening|making a funeral opening gripping|opening with a climax
大模型指令: Present the most arresting outcome first, then gradually explain how it happened. Do not rely on spectacle alone.
核心摘要: An outcome-first opening shows readers the result and sends them searching backward for its causes.
详细展开: Funerals, ruins, trials, and the aftermath of a final battle work well, provided later developments repeatedly change the reader's interpretation of that first image.
说明: A result-first hook establishes suspense, especially in stories driven by discovering the truth.
示例片段: He stood before his own gravestone, listening to everyone discuss his death. None of them knew the coffin held no body.
毒点: An elaborate opening spectacle is never credibly explained, leaving only a gimmick.

关键词: psychological profiling|case analysis|profile-based deduction|evidence profiling
意图与同义词: writing a profiling scene|grounding case analysis|inferring an offender from evidence
大模型指令: Connect every profiling conclusion to evidence at the scene. Do not let analysis resemble clairvoyance.
核心摘要: Profiling tension comes from a few pieces of evidence gradually revealing a frightening, specific person.
详细展开: Organization, excessive violence, trophies taken, and cleanup can support deductions about age, occupation, relationships, and likely future crime locations.
说明: Suited to case conferences, pre-interrogation assessments, and a protagonist's solitary reconstruction.
示例片段: She did not ask about the weapon first. She placed the excessively clean doorknob on the table. 'This isn't caution. It's practice.'
毒点: A character glances at the scene and correctly announces the killer's age, job, and personality without an evidentiary chain.

关键词: ruin logs|archaeological records|mural puzzle|ancient civilization clues
意图与同义词: giving ruins historical depth|writing archaeological logs|revealing truth through murals
大模型指令: Distribute an ancient civilization's truth across murals, fragments, artifacts, and mistranslations. Let the protagonist assemble history piece by piece.
核心摘要: Ruins are compelling when present-day exploration and ancient truths form two narratives layered within the same space.
详细展开: Do not explain the entire past at once. Let broken murals, malfunctioning cores, and incomplete notes fill each other's gaps and progressively overturn assumptions.
说明: Suited to major ruins, ancient settlements, and abandoned bases that reveal the wider world.
示例片段: In the seventh mural, the humans who should have been kneeling before their god wore collars, as though presenting tribute to someone else.
毒点: Narration explains all the history as soon as the protagonist enters, rendering exploration pointless.

关键词: ethical dilemma|ten-second countdown|impossible choice|whom to save
意图与同义词: writing a no-win choice|staging a ten-second decision|saving one or saving many
大模型指令: Allow too little time to find a perfect solution, and make the consequences concrete enough that choosing feels like cutting into oneself.
核心摘要: An ethical dilemma draws power not from philosophical complexity but from everyone's awareness that no perfect answer exists.
详细展开: Include the countdown, watching eyes, public judgment, and later guilt. Make the dilemma a wound-producing event, not an abstract question.
说明: Suited to infinite-instance challenges, disaster rescues, and political decisions requiring an immediate answer.
示例片段: When the number fell to three, he understood: he was not choosing who deserved to live. He was choosing which kind of hatred would follow him for the rest of his life.
毒点: The story calls it a dilemma while hiding a perfect solution, so readers feel no genuine pressure.

关键词: VR login|virtual-reality transition|sensory reset|logging in and out
意图与同义词: writing a VR login|making reality-to-virtual transitions tangible|opening a game world
大模型指令: Disconnect real-world senses first, then reconstruct the virtual world through sound, sight, and touch. Contrast should carry the transition.
核心摘要: A strong VR transition does more than announce entry into a game: it lets readers acquire the new world's senses alongside the protagonist.
详细展开: Darkness, a neural sting, a white loading screen, the first distant wind, and finally the expanded view can create a strong sense of presence.
说明: Suited to VR openings, map changes, and logging out into reality.
示例片段: The wind returned first, then the faint rasp of grass beneath his feet. Only afterward did the sky burst into his vision, as though someone had torn it open.
毒点: 'He entered the game world' is the entire transition, leaving reality and simulation indistinguishable.

关键词: livestreamed evidence|school counterattack|self-incrimination|public reckoning
意图与同义词: writing livestream evidence|publicly reversing school bullying|making a bully expose themselves
大模型指令: The key is not livestreaming itself, but inducing the opponent to confirm their wrongdoing while the evidence is complete and enough witnesses are watching.
核心摘要: A public-evidence counterattack is satisfying when the protagonist barely acts and the opponent destroys their own position in full view.
详细展开: Set camera positions and control the pace while letting the opponent believe they remain in charge, until one remark or action turns public opinion.
说明: Suited to bullying, workplace framing, and public vindication where rules and public scrutiny matter.
示例片段: As the recording light came on, he simply laid the phone on the table and smiled. 'What did you say would happen if you hit me again?'
毒点: The livestream is a gimmick; the reversal actually depends on a conveniently introduced bystander defending the protagonist.

关键词: pre-mission meal|last calm moment|meal before battle|warmth with hidden warning
意图与同义词: writing a meal before battle|planting clues in pre-mission downtime|making the last quiet moment resonate
大模型指令: Relax the table's mood first, then plant a lingering warning through a slip, a missing place setting, or an unnatural silence. Do not begin with conspicuous doom.
核心摘要: Let characters eat, laugh, and tease as usual before the unsettling details emerge at the edges.
详细展开: Use passing food, fighting over seats, drinking, and clearing dishes; hide clues in who becomes quiet or omits a familiar remark.
说明: Suited to brief warmth and warning before a battle, instance, journey, or infiltration.
示例片段: While the others joked that he had better not die too soon, she bent over his old charm and tightened the knot, as if this might be her last chance to finish it for him.
毒点: Repeated warnings of impending disaster undermine both the warmth and the scene's naturalness.

关键词: subtext dialogue|double meanings|displaced conversation|small talk as confrontation
意图与同义词: writing subtext|staging double-edged dialogue|turning small talk into a contest
大模型指令: Let the surface conversation concern A while the real exchange concerns B. Each line should protect something unsayable rather than expose the true intent immediately.
核心摘要: Displaced dialogue works because both people answer the apparent question while defending against another, more important one.
详细展开: Weather, memories, manners, and concern can serve as cover. The real probes often lie in pauses, evasions, and deliberate word choices.
说明: Suited to reunions, interrogations, negotiations, and hierarchical probing where real intentions must remain restrained.
示例片段: He remarked on the heavy rain. She murmured agreement, but her eyes stayed on the freshly stitched tear in his cuff, asking where he had really been last night.
毒点: Within three lines, characters state all their true thoughts; the supposed subtext exists only in labels.

关键词: combat opening|multisensory pressure|moment before contact|prebattle atmosphere
意图与同义词: tightening a fight's opening|writing the instant before battle|building pressure before action
大模型指令: Before the first strike, bring in wind pressure, metal sounds, blood's smell, and the feel of the ground. Tighten the body before releasing the action.
核心摘要: A multisensory opening lets readers hear, smell, and feel approaching danger before the first blade falls.
详细展开: Armor scraping, pebbles shifting, an iron taste in the throat, tingling palms, and shortened breaths turn explanation into physical presence.
说明: Suited to duels, battle openings, and boss entrances that need compression before release.
示例片段: The blade was still sheathed, but the wind had already scraped a chill across his skin. He could even hear the sharp little click of his opponent's ring against the hilt.
毒点: The narration says both fighters are tense, then immediately starts the slashing, with no bodily sense of pressure.

关键词: environmental combat|terrain-assisted reversal|terrain trap|hostile surroundings
意图与同义词: writing terrain-based combat|reversing a fight through the environment|moving beyond named attacks
大模型指令: Treat the terrain as a third opponent capable of causing injury. Footing, sightlines, cover, and environmental hazards must change decisions.
核心摘要: Environmental combat works when the battlefield participates in attack and defense rather than serving as attractive scenery.
详细展开: Crumbling cliffs, rain-slick ground, narrow stairs, zero-gravity warehouses, and anti-magic zones add tactical depth when they can turn against the fighters.
说明: Suited to pursuits, defensive stands, escape fights, and reversals against a stronger opponent.
示例片段: He did not try to be faster. Step by step, he drove his opponent toward the rain-loosened eave stone. When the man pushed off, the whole roof corner collapsed first.
毒点: Despite elaborate terrain, the actual fight unfolds as though on a flat arena floor, making the environment irrelevant.

关键词: villain viewpoint|private decision|villain monologue|contingency planning
意图与同义词: writing a villain viewpoint|staging private plotting|grounding a villain's monologue
大模型指令: Reveal the villain's reasoning and next move through paperwork, surveillance, cleaning blood, or chess. Avoid lengthy speeches to empty air explaining their wickedness.
核心摘要: A private decision scene shows how the villain reads the situation, misjudges it, and rapidly prepares contingencies.
详细展开: Reveal new information while preserving the villain's blind spots. Readers should see intelligence without necessarily learning the whole truth.
说明: Use after a victory or defeat, before advancing a conspiracy, or during a viewpoint shift to display intelligence and methods.
示例片段: He moved the third contingency plan to the top of the pile, acknowledging that the boy was more troublesome than expected, but still not worth confronting personally.
毒点: Alone, the villain recites the entire conspiracy and every secret advantage as though briefing the reader.

关键词: noticing distress|not pressing for answers|tacit care|something feels wrong
意图与同义词: showing someone noticing distress|caring without interrogating|writing unspoken understanding
大模型指令: Someone who understands may change the subject, shield the other person, offer water, or leave space rather than ask questions. Express care through action.
核心摘要: Noticing without pressing reveals deeper understanding than immediately asking what is wrong, because intimacy appears in knowing another person's boundaries.
详细展开: An attentive character senses the change, then quiets down, clears the room, blocks another drink, or simply sits nearby. Such restraint can linger longer than tears.
说明: Suited to a teammate nearing collapse, lovers in a cold war, triggered trauma, or recovery after a failed mission.
示例片段: She did not ask what had happened. She sent the loudest people to fetch medicine and quietly placed warm water beside his hand.
毒点: The instant someone seems upset, everyone crowds around demanding answers, turning delicate concern into an interrogation.

关键词: postbattle evacuation|aftermath of defeat|wounded retreat|closing the aftermath
意图与同义词: writing after defeat|giving retreat a cost|staging battle aftermath
大模型指令: A retreat is not a casualty spreadsheet. Show missing people, mistakes, guilt, and the pressure of what comes next together.
核心摘要: Retreat after defeat reveals cost because characters must keep living with their wounds rather than simply fall and disappear.
详细展开: How the wounded walk, who stays silent, who forces themselves to command, and who cannot look back convey more than 'a crushing defeat.'
说明: Suited to major defeats, failed missions, abandoned defenses, and disasters caused by misjudgment.
示例片段: No one counted the dead. Yet every stretcher-bearer skirted the charred wall, because everyone knew who had been standing there moments earlier.
毒点: The battle ends and the story jumps directly to the next mission, leaving no room to absorb the cost.

关键词: false reconciliation|old friends probing|reminiscence as cover|contested meeting
意图与同义词: reuniting friends who cannot reconcile|staging false reconciliation|hiding probes in reminiscence
大模型指令: Preserve courtesy and old affection, but make each greeting test an edge. Do not mistake an apparent reconciliation for a genuinely settled conflict.
核心摘要: The scene's attraction is that both people know the past cannot return, yet use civility to keep talking.
详细展开: Old names, habits, and shared memories provide a sweet surface. The real test is who first mentions the forbidden subject.
说明: Suited to estranged partners, exes forced to cooperate, and fellow disciples meeting after a rupture.
示例片段: He poured her tea as he always had. But when he turned the cup toward her, his fingers deliberately concealed the old scar she knew so well.
毒点: Within three sentences they either fully reconcile or openly break, skipping the most charged middle ground.

关键词: interrogation|eliciting an admission|pressure through silence|questioning contest
意图与同义词: writing interrogations|making questioning oppressive|staging an elicited confession
大模型指令: Do not rely on shouting. Pressure can come from silence, repetition, displaced information, and letting the other person fill their own gaps.
核心摘要: Silence-driven questioning works when the interrogator knows when not to ask, allowing the suspect to betray themselves in the empty space.
详细展开: A water glass, clock, light, repeated detail checks, or deliberately incorrect timeline can create psychological cracks more effectively than pounding the table.
说明: Suited to police questioning, political examinations, extracting information in enemy territory, or confrontations after a relationship breaks.
示例片段: He did not ask a third time. He merely slid over the ticket with its sequence reversed. The room was quiet enough to hear the other man's throat work.
毒点: The interrogation consists only of shouting and insults, with neither strategy nor psychological progression.

关键词: evidence search|room search|scene examination|searching a room
意图与同义词: writing a room search|making scene examination engaging|staging clue discovery
大模型指令: Search by area, layer, and priority. Each discovery should alter a hypothesis rather than add another item to an inventory.
核心摘要: A systematic search links space and evidence so readers understand why one area is inspected before another.
详细展开: Establish an order for the entrance, desktop, wastebasket, drawer compartments, ceiling, and space behind mirrors. Each clue should open a new line of reasoning.
说明: Suited to locked-room investigations, dormitory inquiries, bedroom searches, and examinations of uncanny scenes.
示例片段: She checked behind the door and the windowsill first: panic makes people patch the obvious gaps. Only the damp half-ticket in the bin finally tore the timeline apart.
毒点: The protagonist enters with a scanner-like cheat and automatically finds every key clue in three seconds.

关键词: ranking announcement|ranking changes|ensemble reactions|results reveal
意图与同义词: making rankings satisfying|ensemble reactions to results|staging score announcements
大模型指令: Do not merely list names. The satisfaction comes from people with different stakes being struck by the same result at once.
核心摘要: One ranking can simultaneously ignite astonishment, jealousy, relief, and the collapse of someone's certainty.
详细展开: Spectators, rivals, teachers, allies, and strangers should react from different positions; contrasts give the announcement depth.
说明: Suited to exam results, combat rankings, points updates, and changes to wanted lists.
示例片段: The first to lose his voice was not the displaced contender, but the instructor who had just told everyone to stop dreaming. He stared at the top name as though he had forgotten how to blink.
毒点: Every bystander reacts with identical shock, leaving all characters emotionally interchangeable.

关键词: unboxing|lottery reveal|reward announcement|hidden reward
意图与同义词: making unboxing satisfying|revealing a rare reward|staging rewards
大模型指令: Reveal rewards in rising layers rather than showing the best item immediately. Arrange expectation, disappointment, and a final surprise.
核心摘要: Layered rewards work when characters and readers believe the reveal is over, only to discover something more remarkable at the bottom.
详细展开: Start with routine rewards, introduce a rare anomaly, then finish with a hidden attribute, resonance, or extra permission.
说明: Suited to completion rewards, lottery boxes, loot division, and system-issued prizes.
示例片段: Everyone was already envying the purple-grade equipment when a blackened card at the bottom turned itself over, as if reminding them the box was not truly open yet.
毒点: Rewards read like a pasted system log, without rhythm, anticipation, or levels of surprise.

关键词: training ground|public instruction|demonstration duel|unexpected teaching upset
意图与同义词: writing training-ground scenes|making instruction satisfying|staging a reversal during a demonstration
大模型指令: Establish the lesson's order and expectations, then let brilliance emerge through a deviation, an improvised counter, or a student's response beyond the syllabus.
核心摘要: A demonstration becomes compelling when an orderly lesson unexpectedly overturns public judgments of ability and understanding.
详细展开: A teacher explains a move, a student makes a mistake, and the protagonist intervenes, surprising observers and authority figures in successive stages.
说明: Suited to academy classes, sect instruction, public demonstrations, and master-disciple sparring.
示例片段: The elder intended only to demonstrate the opening stance. Before he finished explaining, the boy below had followed the half-inch gap into every subsequent move.
毒点: The lesson only explains the setting, with no movement, mistakes, corrections, or live reactions.

关键词: festival scene|assassination under fireworks|celebration turns dangerous|ceremonial disaster
意图与同义词: turning festivities into crisis|writing a festival assassination|staging danger under fireworks
大模型指令: Fill the scene with celebration first, then tear it open with one small missed beat. Let danger emerge from the crowd, lights, and music.
核心摘要: The louder the celebration, the more striking the sense that danger has grown out of the splendor itself.
详细展开: A skipped drumbeat, misaligned lights, fireworks, obstructed views, and laughter can conceal assassination, disappearance, or a triggered rule.
说明: Suited to lantern festivals, victory banquets, school festivals, weddings, and citywide celebrations.
示例片段: When the fireworks burst, the whole city looked up. Only she saw the dagger below the steps change direction instead of returning to its sheath.
毒点: Celebration and danger are disconnected: half the chapter tours the fair, then abruptly cuts to an assassination.

关键词: returning to an old place|looking back|a familiar place changed|setting contrast
意图与同义词: making a return powerful|showing change through revisiting|staging a changed familiar place
大模型指令: Do not merely lament change. Contrast old and new details at the same location to reveal exactly how people and circumstances have altered.
核心摘要: The emotional force lies not in nostalgia alone, but in recognizing that neither the character nor the world remains the same.
详细展开: The same table, street, or classroom can evoke change through altered use, positions, and emotional associations.
说明: Suited to homecoming after growth, returning to a crime scene, or revisiting a place after a relationship ends.
示例片段: The noodle shop remained, but the person who once picked scallions from his bowl at the window was gone. This time, he finally left the cilantro where it was.
毒点: The return offers vague sentiment without concrete contrasts or evidence of personal change.

关键词: whiteboard deduction|team breakthrough|case conference|reasoning session
意图与同义词: writing group deduction|making problem-solving meetings lively|staging whiteboard reasoning
大模型指令: Let each person contribute a limited perspective and their own mistakes. Truth should emerge from competing views, not one person's monologue.
核心摘要: Wrong hypotheses, partial truths, and decisive counterevidence become compelling when they collide around the same table.
详细展开: Maps, whiteboards, rule sheets, timelines, and replayed footage can make changing thought processes visible and keep the scene lively.
说明: Suited to instance debriefs, team investigations, tactical simulations, and checking rules through collective reasoning.
示例片段: When he circled the third rule, the quietest person shook her head first. Only she had noticed that the duty roster lacked a name that should never have been absent.
毒点: The supposed group deduction consists entirely of the protagonist explaining while everyone else nods in amazement.

关键词: auction|bidding|raising the price|covert contest|headline lot
意图与同义词: writing auctions|staging bidding warfare|writing an auction bargain
大模型指令: Track price, status pressure, and information gaps together. Do not reduce bidding to mechanical numbers.
核心摘要: Auction satisfaction comes not just from rising prices but from bids that probe hidden resources, assert status, or create misdirection.
详细展开: Headline lots, shill bidders, silent bids, private-box viewpoints, and last-second raises can give the exchange both wealth and hostility.
说明: Suited to auction houses, underground fairs, sect-resource auctions, and competition for rare objects.
示例片段: Before the third bell finished, a languid voice drifted from the highest box. The bid sounded casual, yet every real expert below abruptly sat upright.
毒点: Only the auctioneer's numbers change; no one tests status, and the atmosphere never shifts.

关键词: rainy-night confrontation|under the eaves|old romantic conflict|night rain
意图与同义词: writing confrontation in rain|creating tension beneath an awning|staging old feelings on a rainy night
大模型指令: Let rain and cramped shelter exert pressure together. Put the unsaid into pauses and gestures rather than having characters stand and recite.
核心摘要: Tension comes from encroaching surroundings and old grievances caught in the throat: the closer the bodies, the fewer the words.
详细展开: Rain streaks, puddles, a borrowed umbrella, a half-step retreat, and forced proximity bind relational conflict to physical distance.
说明: Suited to old lovers clashing, probing questions, and close encounters between uncertain allies or enemies.
示例片段: The rain drove her onto the half-inch of dry ground beneath the eaves. He stayed at its edge, each word falling with the water like a weight.
毒点: The narration mentions rain, but the characters explain everything in ordinary, unpressured conversation.

关键词: press conference|public response|public-opinion reversal|reporter confrontation
意图与同义词: making press conferences satisfying|staging public vindication|turning a news conference around
大模型指令: Drive public opinion and expectations to their lowest point before reversing them through the order of evidence and statements. Do not reveal everything immediately.
核心摘要: The payoff is not merely presenting evidence: everyone expects an apology, then watches the situation overturn piece by piece.
详细展开: Microphones, livestream comments, sponsors' expressions, reporters' questions, and projected documents build pressure that timed evidence releases can reverse.
说明: Suited to PR responses, public school clarifications, business disputes, and vindication in entertainment.
示例片段: He bowed first, and the flashbulbs went wild. Then the signed timetable appeared on the screen, and the investors in the front row were the first to fall silent.
毒点: The protagonist reveals all evidence at the outset, leaving no mistaken expectation, pressure, or rhythm of reversal.

关键词: fake dating|fake marriage|pretend relationship|playing a part
意图与同义词: writing fake dating|creating sparks in a false relationship|staging a pretend couple
大模型指令: Maintain both the external mission and internal loss of control. Each coordinated gesture can contain a small, genuine emotional deviation.
核心摘要: The attraction is that both characters know they are acting, yet some detail feels real before either expects it.
详细展开: Holding hands, changing forms of address, shielding someone from a drink, an arm around a shoulder, and a shared cover story can collide with real emotional defenses.
说明: Suited to managing relatives, infiltrating an event, contractual relationships, and mutual exploitation becoming affection.
示例片段: She offered her hand only to make the act convincing. But he smoothed her hair so naturally that the older relatives beside them smiled first.
毒点: The story says they are pretending to be a couple but supplies no situation requiring cooperation or emotional slippage.

关键词: late-night duty|night shift|uncanny stillness|movement in an empty building
意图与同义词: making night duty frightening|creating night-shift unease|staging an empty building
大模型指令: Establish the normal shift routine, then tilt its order with one tiny missed beat. Let strangeness grow out of excessive quiet.
核心摘要: Night-shift fear need not rely on jump scares; an impossible silence or error inside a familiar routine can suffice.
详细展开: Clocking in, patrols, monitors, rosters, announcements, thermoses, and floor lights make effective points of deviation precisely because they are ordinary.
说明: Suited to hospitals, schools, offices, dormitories, and stations after hours.
示例片段: Every air conditioner in the building stopped at once. Only the clock ticked in the security room, while on the monitor the corridor lights kept coming on, one after another.
毒点: Jump scares and bloody writing provide all the fear, with no routine or environmental order for contrast.

关键词: station farewell|dockside goodbye|platform parting|missed farewell
意图与同义词: writing farewells|avoiding clichéd station goodbyes|staging a dockside parting
大模型指令: Do not rush toward sentiment. Put the time limit, obstacles to movement, and unfinished words onstage together.
核心摘要: A platform or dockside farewell hurts because time has already moved on before people can say what matters, not because they shout or cry.
详细展开: Whistles, ticket checks, mooring lines, announcements, mist, and crowds can become a countdown, forcing goodbye into fragmented gestures.
说明: Suited to journeys, final partings, undercover departures, prewar separations, and missed reunions.
示例片段: At the third boarding call, he was still pulling her scarf higher, as if moving slowly enough could keep the train from leaving.
毒点: Both characters stand delivering long farewell speeches while the setting's time pressure becomes irrelevant.

关键词: hospital vigil|bedside care|night conversation|words left unsaid
意图与同义词: writing a hospital vigil|giving bedside conversation emotion|staging a sickroom scene
大模型指令: Carry emotion through lowered voices, the sleeping patient, and restrained gestures. Do not turn the room into a grand confession stage.
核心摘要: The need to speak softly, move slowly, and contain emotion makes every detail weigh more heavily.
详细展开: Peeling an apple, tucking in a blanket, watching a monitor, replacing hot water, and abandoning half a sentence can deepen relationships more than sobbing.
说明: Suited to easing old resentment, renewed family warmth, partial revelations, and relationship changes after a crisis.
示例片段: He shifted his chair back half an inch, afraid a scrape would wake her. The apology he should have offered long ago stayed caught in his throat for half the night.
毒点: People argue loudly or explain at length, ignoring both the hospital setting and the rhythm of a vigil.

关键词: reporter ambush|persistent questioning|cameras and microphones|media scrum
意图与同义词: writing a reporter scrum|staging media questions|responding when reporters block the exit
大模型指令: Show scrutiny, the rhythm of questions, and restricted escape routes. Every response should feel like crossing a narrow bridge.
核心摘要: The pressure comes from relentless questions, cameras close to the face, and no time to think a complete thought.
详细展开: Elevator doors, parking lots, hospitals, and school gates suit these scenes. Blocking, crowding, intercepting, and pursuing turn space into psychological pressure.
说明: Suited to scandals, case inquiries, exposed identities, and collapsing public relations.
示例片段: Only when a microphone nearly touched her chin did she realize the greatest danger was not the questioner, but the person outside the frame waiting for her first wrong word.
毒点: Reporters ask two token questions in the background, with no spatial pressure or sustained follow-up.

关键词: scene card|purpose conflict turn result|scene structure|scene goal
意图与同义词: writing a scene outline|breaking down a scene card|keeping a scene focused
大模型指令: Specify purpose, conflict, turning point, and result before adding setting, action, dialogue, and emotion.
核心摘要: The four-part scene card keeps chapters cohesive and gives each scene a job in advancing the story.
详细展开: Purpose explains why the scene exists; conflict keeps readers engaged; the turn changes its course; the result determines how the next scene begins.
说明: Suited to chapter breakdowns, scene outlines, resolving writer's block, and prewriting briefs.
示例片段: She enters to recover the ledger, not to chat. Silence at dinner is the conflict; her mother slamming down the chopsticks is the turn; forcing the household split forward is the result.
毒点: The outline names only a place and characters, with no purpose or result, so the finished scene advances nothing identifiable.

关键词: heated argument|rapid escalation|loss of control|aftermath
意图与同义词: writing an argument|staging a high-pressure dispute|avoiding padded conflict dialogue
大模型指令: Begin with a tolerable sting, escalate until the real wound is exposed, and leave consequences for the relationship.
核心摘要: An intense argument is not a volume contest; each line should move closer to the central wound.
详细展开: Start with restraint and probing, move through questions and counterattacks, say the unsayable at the peak, then use silence or departure to prove the relationship has changed.
说明: Suited to lovers breaking apart, parent-child clashes, partners falling out, and old grievances coming due.
示例片段: She never raised her voice. Only when he said, 'You're just like her,' did the cup in her hand finally strike the table's edge.
毒点: The argument begins at maximum intensity, never escalates, and ends without consequences.

关键词: patience breaking|accumulated repression|breaking point|emotional release
意图与同义词: writing an outburst after long restraint|releasing pent-up emotion|staging accumulated grievance
大模型指令: First establish why the character cannot retaliate. When restraint breaks, the eruption must change the situation or relationship.
核心摘要: The force comes from knowing the character can endure, but that this time they genuinely cannot endure more.
详细展开: Repeated concessions, misunderstandings, covering for others, and crossed boundaries build pressure. Make the threshold a specific word or action.
说明: Suited to underdog reversals, family oppression, workplace vindication, and emotional ruptures.
示例片段: The first three times, he bent to gather the papers. The fourth time, when the other man's shoe pinned the diagnosis to the floor, he finally stayed upright.
毒点: Without accumulated restraint, the sudden outburst merely makes the character seem bad-tempered.

关键词: sudden confession|emotional defenses fail|expressing love|response shock
意图与同义词: writing a confession|avoiding awkward sudden declarations|staging a rush of affection
大模型指令: Give emotion a reason to force its way out. Do not present the confession as an isolated proclamation.
核心摘要: A sudden confession works when the character could have kept resisting until one detail in the moment broke their defenses.
详细展开: Build emotion through companionship, misunderstanding, or danger. Keep the confession brief and precise; the response need not be happy, but it must alter the relationship.
说明: Suited to sweet romance, reunions, rescue crises, and breaking romantic ambiguity.
示例片段: She asked why he had returned. Looking at the old red cord around her wrist, he finally said, 'Because I was afraid you'd really stop waiting.'
毒点: With no emotional buildup, a character abruptly delivers a long declaration of love.

关键词: rupture|final farewell|severed relationship|unsaid words
意图与同义词: writing a relationship rupture|giving farewell resonance|writing a breakup
大模型指令: Show both the attempt to repair things and the gap that cannot be bridged. Do not rely solely on 'I'll never see you again.'
核心摘要: A genuine rupture may arise not from love ending, but from recognizing that staying will only make things worse.
详细展开: Returning an object, abandoning a familiar name, closing a door, or missing the last words can mark the break and make the aftermath hurt more than dialogue.
说明: Suited to breakups, severed master-disciple bonds, leaving a family, and faction splits.
示例片段: She returned the key to the bowl by the door. Its small metallic chime finished the goodbye she could not say.
毒点: After shouting cruel lines, both people immediately leave, with no concrete breaking point or lingering effect.

关键词: ensemble cooking|everyday activity|casual foreshadowing|small relationship shifts
意图与同义词: writing ensemble downtime|planting clues while cooking|making casual talk useful
大模型指令: Give the scene an ongoing activity, and let characters speak, reveal personality, and disclose information through action.
核心摘要: Good downtime advances relationships and setup while people work, rather than stopping everything for conversation.
详细展开: Cooking, dividing loot, tidying, cards, traveling, and repairs can carry relaxed interaction. Every casual remark should serve character, relationship, or foreshadowing.
说明: Suited to team rest, family life, farming or business stories, and mid-volume decompression.
示例片段: His spatula moved steadily as he complained about her salt. Only the child beside them noticed him place the tenderest piece of meat in her bowl.
毒点: Everyone sits talking without revealing character or planting anything for later.

关键词: family dinner|pressure from elders|double meanings|seating hierarchy
意图与同义词: writing dinner-table scenes|staging a family pressure cooker|making relatives' meals oppressive
大模型指令: Show power through seats, serving food, paused chopsticks, and changing forms of address. Do not carry every pressure through dialogue.
核心摘要: The family table brings affection, obligation, and interests into the same confined space.
详细展开: Who takes the head seat, who is excluded, who receives food, and who cleans up can reveal family rank and hidden tensions.
说明: Suited to impending household division, scrutiny of relationships, pressure from relatives, and resurfacing grievances.
示例片段: Second Uncle nudged the fish toward the eldest son. No one spoke, but she already knew she had not been invited home simply to eat.
毒点: Dinner is mere scenery while characters stand and argue, with no domestic etiquette or layered relationships.

关键词: period everyday life|ration coupons and goods|dialect and slang|historical detail
意图与同义词: creating period atmosphere|writing courtyard-house life|avoiding piles of period props
大模型指令: Period details must serve character and conflict. Put household goods, ration coupons, work units, and neighborhood ties into action.
核心摘要: Historical authenticity comes from constraints on everyday life, not a list of old objects.
详细展开: Grain and cloth coupons, enamel mugs, supply cooperatives, work-unit housing, neighbors' scrutiny, and alley gossip should affect choices.
说明: Suited to courtyard homes, work units, supply cooperatives, family meals, and neighborhood disputes.
示例片段: She hid the cloth coupons beneath the enamel mug, not because she feared losing them, but because the neighbor would use them as another excuse to arrange a match.
毒点: Old objects are listed without letting the period's institutions influence anyone's actions.

关键词: rule notice|handing out guidelines|entering through rules|abnormal clauses
意图与同义词: opening a rules-horror story|presenting rule notices|making guidelines frightening
大模型指令: Make the rules actionable like a real notice, then introduce one or two anomalies to unsettle the reader.
核心摘要: The key is not frightening adjectives, but understanding that following the instructions is necessary to survive.
详细展开: Noticeboards, manuals, dorm rules, announcements, and texts can carry the rules. Make anomalies precise enough to support later deduction.
说明: Suited to instance openings, school horror, hospital night shifts, and enclosed spaces.
示例片段: The first line said to remain quiet after lights-out. The second said that if you heard your own voice in the corridor, you must answer immediately.
毒点: Rules read like atmospheric poetry, so readers cannot tell how to obey them or reason from them.

关键词: whiteboard deduction|clue review|hypothesis testing|evidence puzzle
意图与同义词: writing a reasoning recap|connecting clues|keeping whiteboard deduction lively
大模型指令: Let clues, hypotheses, and counterevidence progressively narrow the possibilities. Do not let the protagonist simply lecture on the answer.
核心摘要: The scene becomes readable when the reader joins the characters in eliminating wrong paths.
详细展开: Group clues, propose hypotheses, refute them one by one, and retain one unexplained detail to combine clarity with suspense.
模式名称: Clue review through hypothesis and refutation
说明: Suited to checking rules, revisiting cases, escaping instances, and the eve of a revelation.
示例片段: When he crossed the third name off the whiteboard, nobody spoke. The remaining answer was more frightening than the mistakes.
毒点: The scene becomes a long explanation unrelated to earlier clues, leaving the reader to listen passively.

关键词: mission settlement|system space|world debrief|rewards and penalties
意图与同义词: writing world-hopping settlements|transitioning after a mission|avoiding mechanical system-space recaps
大模型指令: Review emotional aftermath, mission gains and losses, and the next world's hook together. Do not merely announce a score.
核心摘要: Settlement releases the completed episode's emotions while opening anticipation for the next one.
详细展开: Land the character's feelings first, then examine mission metrics, and finish with rewards, penalties, or an anomalous alert so the transition feels organic.
说明: Suited to episode endings, hidden storylines, failure penalties, and growth across worlds.
示例片段: When the screen's grade jumped to A, she noticed the small print first: THE TARGET RETAINED THEIR MEMORIES AFTER YOUR DEPARTURE.
毒点: Only scores and reward lists appear, with no emotional residue from the previous world.

关键词: account review and expansion|ledger scene|business review|supply-chain pressure
意图与同义词: writing a business review|staging agricultural expansion|making ledgers dramatic
大模型指令: Show revenue, costs, shortfalls, and the next risks so business growth has concrete traction.
核心摘要: The satisfaction lies not in numbers alone, but in seeing the enterprise genuinely grow through the character's efforts.
详细展开: Ledgers, IOUs, stock, wastage, orders, and staffing gaps can all introduce the next phase of the plot.
说明: Suited to shop expansion, farming stockpiles, period trading, and early business rivalry.
示例片段: She crossed off the final kerosene expense and realized the month's profit was modest, but enough to rent the vacant room next door as a storehouse.
毒点: The ledger merely says they made a lot of money, with no costs, shortages, or coming pressures.

关键词: paywall hook|short-story break|instant before the answer|strong hook
意图与同义词: writing a paywall break|where to split a short story|making a break convert readers
大模型指令: Stop between peak emotional pressure and the unanswered question. The next section must promptly deliver a payoff.
核心摘要: A paywall hook is not an arbitrary chapter break: it makes readers urgently need the answer.
详细展开: Introduce evidence, a name, or an anomalous action; let the character recognize the consequences; stop just before revelation or necessary action.
说明: Suited to Zhihu-style shorts, reversal-heavy stories, social realism, and suspense shorts.
示例片段: The person outside called my mother by her childhood nickname. She had been dead for ten years. As I reached for the door, my phone lit up: DON'T ANSWER.
毒点: The break interrupts irrelevant walking or drinking, and the paid section offers no immediate payoff.

关键词: first person|inner monologue|immersion|I-perspective
意图与同义词: writing first person|immersive first-person short stories|natural inner monologue
大模型指令: Advance through immediate senses and limited knowledge. Do not turn the narrator into a machine explaining the whole situation.
核心摘要: Immersive first person depends on what I know now, what I fear, and what I have misunderstood.
详细展开: Keep inner thoughts brief and responsive, sensory details relevant to the immediate situation, and information within the character's knowledge.
说明: Suited to short-story openings, suspense misdirection, emotionally focused romance, and intense conflict.
示例片段: I smelled disinfectant before I saw the death certificate on the table. The name on it was mine.
毒点: A first-person narrator absent from the scene explains everyone else's thoughts and the entire hidden conspiracy.

关键词: fantasy combat|power system|tactical shifts|visual impact
意图与同义词: writing fantasy battles|showing cultivation ranks in combat|giving fights layers
大模型指令: Keep rank differences, technique effects, environmental changes, and decisions on the same rhythmic line.
核心摘要: Fantasy combat is the visible operation of power rules, not a pile of attack names.
详细展开: Establish the power gap, move through probing and adaptation, climax in a breakthrough or reversal, and close with costs and consequences.
模式名称: Combat that visualizes the power system
说明: Suited to duels, victories against higher ranks, sect tournaments, and deadly pursuits.
示例片段: The sword energy did not explode against the protective aura. It bent beneath an invisible tide, and everyone realized the difference between them was far more than a technique or two.
毒点: Named attacks and light effects appear continuously without power differences, strategy, or meaningful damage.

关键词: group combat|positions and roles|combined attack|team coordination
意图与同义词: writing team battles|keeping multi-person fights clear|arranging teamwork
大模型指令: Establish space and roles first, then shift viewpoint with the changing battle. Do not have every character compete for the same highlight.
核心摘要: Readers must know who is where, what each person does, and how the situation changes.
详细展开: Use frontline, ranged, control, healing, main damage, and decoy roles to organize rhythm. Cut between viewpoints only for decisive actions.
说明: Suited to team instances, sect melees, esports team fights, and battlefield squads.
示例片段: The shield cultivator stepped forward half a pace, sealing the spellcaster's exposed flank. A heartbeat later, talisman fire skimmed past his shoulder.
毒点: Everyone charges and unleashes a finishing move at once, leaving readers unable to follow the space or anyone's contribution.

关键词: contradictory rules|true and false rules|rule comparison|different conditions
意图与同义词: writing conflicting rules|presenting false rules|letting readers reason through contradictions
大模型指令: Test the two rules in different situations so readers can discover each one's scope.
核心摘要: A contradiction can point toward conditions involving identity, time, or location rather than an authorial mistake.
详细展开: Different rule sheets, a broadcast contradicting a note, or NPC behavior offering counterevidence can gradually provoke suspicion.
模式名称: Testing the conditions of contradictory rules
说明: Suited to rules horror, enclosed instances, hospitals, schools, and alternate spaces.
示例片段: The dormitory notice said never to open after a knock. The corridor broadcast kept repeating: OPEN IMMEDIATELY FOR ROOM INSPECTION.
毒点: The protagonist declares one rule false without any attempt to test the contradiction.

关键词: oppressive horror|sounds in silence|spatial anomaly|sensory escalation
意图与同义词: creating rules-horror atmosphere|escalating dread|frightening without jump scares
大模型指令: Establish ordinary order first, then introduce a progressively abnormal visual, auditory, or tactile detail.
核心摘要: Rules horror gains its fear from everyday life slowly twisting out of shape rather than repeated jump scares.
详细展开: Silence, delayed lights, mismatched footsteps, wrong smells, and repeating spaces create strong pressure with small anomalies.
说明: Suited to night shifts, dorms, hospitals, schools, stations, and instance corridors.
示例片段: The elevator stopped on every floor, but every door opened onto the same corridor, down to the torn corner of the same poster.
毒点: A bloody hand immediately hits the window, with no normal order or gradual distortion established first.

关键词: tribulation|lightning trial|inner demons|breakthrough phenomena
意图与同义词: writing a cultivation tribulation|making lightning oppressive|staging an inner-demon trial
大模型指令: Combine external heavenly pressure with internal demons so advancement requires more than endurance.
核心摘要: The world bears down on the character while old wounds do the same; both trials must be overcome.
详细展开: Storm clouds, spiritual pressure, guardians, visions of old acquaintances, karmic echoes, and unstable cultivation can add layers.
说明: Suited to major rank breakthroughs, emotional trials, sect defense, and stage climaxes.
示例片段: She held steady beneath the first lightning strike. Only when the inner demon spoke in her master's voice—'You are unworthy'—did her sword tip tremble.
毒点: Nine lightning strikes occur and advancement succeeds, with no inner struggle or cost.

关键词: world entry|receiving an identity|host memories|mission prompt
意图与同义词: entering a world-hopping setting|writing identity acquisition|presenting the original host's memories
大模型指令: Establish identity, crisis, mission, and the original host's emotions quickly, without a lengthy setting broadcast.
核心摘要: An episode opening should immediately reveal where this world's problem applies pressure.
详细展开: Assemble identity and danger through the awakening scene, bodily injuries, phone messages, others' forms of address, and brief system prompts.
说明: Suited to an episode's first chapter, a sudden mission change, and openings built on mistaken identity.
示例片段: She opened her eyes to a sneering 'Madam.' The ink on the divorce papers in her hand was still wet. The system reported the target's affection at minus ninety.
毒点: The system delivers the complete setting in one block while the immediate scene exerts no pressure.

关键词: social realism|everyday detail|restrained emotion|social pressures
意图与同义词: writing emotion in social realism|grounding feelings in daily life|avoiding melodramatic family conflict
大模型指令: Embed emotion in ordinary actions and social pressure instead of repeatedly declaring pain.
核心摘要: Small actions become moving when readers can see the large fractures in a relationship beneath them.
详细展开: Cooking, cleaning, sending money, seeking treatment, queuing, and moving house can carry family ties, obligation, and material pressures.
说明: Suited to family tensions, neighborhood conflict, workplace strain, and cracks in a marriage.
示例片段: She smiled as she pushed the meat broth toward her younger brother. Her own chopsticks stayed beside the pickled vegetables.
毒点: The character delivers a long grievance monologue without everyday actions or real relationships to support it.

关键词: replacement-lover subtext|silent probing|avoiding topics|old names
意图与同义词: writing stand-in romance dialogue|writing subtext|making cold-war dialogue tense
大模型指令: Let outward peace coexist with a deeper sting. Silence and changing the subject can be more powerful than direct statements.
核心摘要: In replacement-lover stories, tension often lies in what remains unsaid; forms of address and pauses should signal the approaching truth.
详细展开: An old name, matching preferences, a sudden correction, an avoided name, or an overlong silence can carry subtext.
说明: Suited to ambiguous attraction, the eve of discovery, estrangement, and attempts to win back a partner.
示例片段: He stopped the instant the wrong name left his mouth. She smiled and finished for him: 'You meant her, didn't you?'
毒点: Every truth and feeling is stated at once, leaving no space for subtext.

关键词: mission collapse|plot deviation|affection crash|system alarm
意图与同义词: writing a failed world-hopping mission|showing extreme deviation|staging an affection collapse
大模型指令: Combine system alarms, character reactions, and material consequences. Do not merely report a falling number.
核心摘要: The tension comes from the mission objective and the real people both escaping control.
详细展开: Sudden affection drops, soaring deviation, exposed identity, and a shortened countdown must affect actions in the scene.
说明: Suited to mid-episode reversals, mission failure, a target discovering manipulation, and exposed identities.
示例片段: By the system's third alarm, he still had not asked why she had lied. He simply pushed the mission item back across the table toward her.
毒点: The story reports affection dropping by fifty, with no personal reaction or practical consequence.

关键词: busy farming season|racing the harvest|rice transplanting|drying grain|neighborly help
意图与同义词: writing farm work|making a harvest urgent|avoiding a labor inventory
大模型指令: Show weather, stamina, tools, and allocation of people so the labor directly affects income and relationships.
核心摘要: Farm-work scenes become engaging through time pressure and collective coordination, not a chronological list of tasks.
详细展开: Harvesting, drying grain, transplanting rice, and repairing canals can reveal neighborhood ties, household roles, and material risks.
说明: Suited to urgent harvests, stockpiling before hardship, family reconciliation, and mutual aid.
示例片段: The first thunder rolled along the horizon. Everyone in the yard fell silent and hurried the last two baskets of grain under the eaves.
毒点: The narration says everyone worked hard all day, but gives no weather, tools, or specific division of labor.

关键词: esports match|ban and pick|team-fight reversal|commentator reactions
意图与同义词: writing esports matches|writing draft phases|staging team fights
大模型指令: Make clear what each side risks in the draft and why the team-fight result changes the match.
核心摘要: Show the value of choices, resources, and execution together instead of merely declaring the competition exciting.
详细展开: Bans and picks, composition counters, vision contests, key cooldowns, and pauses in commentary make matches legible.
模式名称: From draft to decisive team fight
说明: Suited to professional and school tournaments, online guild wars, and competitive sports structures.
示例片段: The commentator had just said their lineup lacked initiation when he locked the final pick into the least fashionable support slot.
毒点: The teams enter the match and the protagonist plays brilliantly, but tactics and competitive rhythm are absent.

关键词: imperial court|formal response|impeachment|shifting a verdict
意图与同义词: writing court politics|making impeachment tense|staging historical political intrigue
大模型指令: Show procedure, position, forms of address, and shifting interests. Do not write court deliberations as an ordinary argument.
核心摘要: Every sentence can implicate an office, family, or faction, creating the court's pressure.
详细展开: Who steps forward first, who remains silent, who cites precedent, and who submits a memorial reveal the movement of power.
说明: Suited to impeachment, exoneration, arranged royal marriages, military debates, and political realignment.
示例片段: When the censor reached the third charge, several ministers on the eastern side lowered their heads. Everyone knew the wind had changed.
毒点: Officials speak freely as in an ordinary meeting, without ceremonial rules or procedure.

关键词: emergency repairs|spacewalk|oxygen countdown|technical failure
意图与同义词: writing science-fiction repairs|writing space rescue|making engineering failures tense
大模型指令: Clarify time, steps, failure risks, and resource limits in emergency repairs.
核心摘要: Science-fiction rescue tension comes from calm execution under an approaching deadline.
详细展开: Remaining oxygen, communication delay, pressure valves, backup power, and missing tools provide concrete pressure points.
说明: Suited to spacecraft accidents, post-apocalyptic equipment repair, base blackouts, and external rescues.
示例片段: Nine minutes of oxygen remained, yet he switched off the lights first. The power was needed for the airlock's final release.
毒点: One universal button fixes the machinery, with no technical constraint or chance of failure.

关键词: iconic-scene variation|canon echo|alternate-timeline divergence|returning dialogue
意图与同义词: rewriting an iconic fanfiction scene|staging canon echoes|dramatizing an alternate timeline
大模型指令: First awaken the reader's memory of canon, then create a new divergence through a choice.
核心摘要: A derivative scene gains power when familiarity and new change coexist.
详细展开: Old dialogue, props, places, and an originally failed outcome can provide echoes, but the new divergence must carry a cost.
模式名称: Canon-echo variation on an iconic scene
说明: Suited to changing a canonical fate, alternate timelines, original-character intervention, and resolving regrets.
示例片段: As he spoke the line that should have been his last, someone caught his wrist first this time.
毒点: The scene simply recreates canon without a new choice or subsequent cost.

关键词: period morning|ration-coupon life|factory work|courtyard bustle
意图与同义词: writing period daily life|writing a courtyard morning|staging the hours before factory work
大模型指令: Blend objects, time pressure, and neighbors' scrutiny into action. Avoid a nostalgic inventory.
核心摘要: Everyday texture emerges as characters live within their era's resource constraints.
详细展开: Cooking, queues, fetching water, the work bell, and courtyard greetings can evoke the period.
说明: Suited to chapter openings, transitions, character introductions, and relationship setup.
示例片段: The cornmeal porridge had only just begun to bubble when someone at the courtyard gate called to borrow a flame. The wall clock left ten minutes before work.
毒点: Enamel mugs, army coats, and bicycles are listed without any character action or pressure.

关键词: work-unit meeting|model-worker selection|workshop dispute|collective declaration
意图与同义词: writing period work-unit meetings|staging model-worker selection|writing workshop arguments
大模型指令: Show seating, speaking order, and collective statements. Do not treat the meeting as a modern company check-in.
核心摘要: The work unit's pressure comes from organizational judgments entering personal life.
详细展开: Silence, being called by name, a record book, and a leader's single remark can create oppression.
说明: Suited to competition for allocations, disciplinary announcements, honors, and job reassignment.
示例片段: The Party secretary reached the final page before looking up. Nobody cracked another sunflower seed: that column held the recommendation.
毒点: The boss invites unrestricted brainstorming, making the scene feel like an internet company's weekly meeting.

关键词: canal building and land clearing|division of labor|tool detail|weather pressure
意图与同义词: writing canal construction|writing land-clearing labor|dramatizing agricultural development
大模型指令: Show terrain, tools, staffing, and disputes over water shares so construction encounters tangible resistance.
核心摘要: Agricultural construction becomes engaging when sweat, soil, and rules jointly change material reality.
详细展开: Hoes, earth baskets, wooden stakes, water levels, and villagers' roles can make progress visible.
说明: Suited to irrigation, land clearing, road building, granaries, and disaster preparation.
示例片段: At the third row of stakes, the water finally turned. The old man who had argued hardest was the first to jump into the ditch and brace a spade.
毒点: The protagonist announces a canal; in the next paragraph it is finished and every villager is grateful.

关键词: market trial sales|stall calls|customer bargaining|repeat-customer feedback
意图与同义词: writing market days|writing stall sales|avoiding mechanical trial-sale scenes
大模型指令: Advance the business through foot traffic, stall placement, bargaining, and reactions to samples.
核心摘要: A market tests products, reputation, and prices rather than merely providing scenery.
详细展开: A demanding customer, a competing vendor, and a returning buyer can form a compact feedback cycle.
说明: Suited to testing products, opening a stall, spreading word of mouth, and price contests.
示例片段: The old woman took a bite without praising it. Instead, she asked whether they would be back tomorrow, already pinning a coin to the corner of the stall cloth.
毒点: The food is declared delicious and immediately sells out, with no bargaining or market feedback.

关键词: arrival in a new world|identity crisis|system prompt|host-memory fragments
意图与同义词: opening a world-hopping episode|writing arrival in a new world|inserting host memories
大模型指令: Present immediate danger first, then supply mission information in fragments. Do not open with a long explanation.
核心摘要: The episode opening should immediately show readers who has wronged the original host.
详细展开: Being caught, humiliated, rejected in marriage, or pursued can create a strong opening predicament.
说明: Suited to each world's first scene, identity changes, mission assignment, and demonstrations of world rules.
示例片段: When she opened her eyes, it was not the system she heard, but a hall full of wedding guests waiting for her to confess to the forged love letter.
毒点: Three thousand words explain the world before the protagonist slowly begins the mission.

关键词: mission settlement|abnormal rating|silent system|episode aftertaste
意图与同义词: writing world-hopping settlements|writing system ratings|leaving a hook at an episode's end
